title: Multi-language Support
meta: Reply to customers in their own language with checked wording and a human fallback. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
overview: If customers write to you in languages your team does not speak, we set up support that detects the language, replies in kind and shows your agents an English version beside the original. Product names and policy terms stay fixed so they are never mistranslated. For each language we test a set of your real questions and tell you honestly which languages are strong and which need a native check.

pkgs.blurb: Two extra languages for your support replies.
Up to five languages, tested on your real questions.
Up to ten languages with tone checks and a review plan.
list: Tone and formality set per language
Native review plan for key phrases

faq: Is the translation good enough for customers?
For everyday support it is usually clear and polite. For legal or sensitive topics we recommend a native speaker. We tell you which languages tested strongest on your own questions.
Most widely used languages such as Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Arabic, Chinese and Japanese. Tell us your list and we confirm each before we start.
Will my product names get translated by mistake?
No. We build a glossary of names and terms that must stay as written, and we test that they survive in every language you add.
Does my team need to speak the language?
No. They read an English version and reply in English if they wish, and the reply is sent in the customer language. A person always reviews anything sensitive.
